note: What's new on AGSIST, newest first. scripts/build_whats_new.py bakes the newest 4 into the homepage card and every entry into /changelog (above the older hand-written log). Only things that are live on the site. Plain words, no em dashes.

items.title: New menu and ZIP chip
items.line: The menu is now Prices, Livestock, Field, Money & Land and Daily. Save your ZIP once and the header chip takes you to bids near your town.

items.title: County stories
items.line: Short written stories on 2,632 county rain pages, 2,876 PRF county pages and 2,902 Farmland Atlas county pages, each dated and checked against our numbers.

items.title: Glossary
items.line: 27 market and farm program terms in plain words. A dotted underline on a page opens the short meaning.

items.title: Real Rain Print photos
items.line: The Rain Print pages now show photos of real framed prints.

items.title: Bids by state
items.line: Every state with cash bids on one page, with the towns and elevators in each.

items.title: More elevators
items.line: Cash bids now come from 1,869 elevator locations, up from 1,763 on Oct 16.

items.title: PRF grid index email
items.line: Pick your PRF grid and get an email when its rainfall index posts.

items.title: More sale barns
items.line: 88 sale barns from USDA reports plus 20 read from their own reports, including Premier Livestock in Withee, WI.

items.title: January county rain total email
items.line: On any county rain page, ask for that county's full-year rain total by email in January.
